Booking.title: Book a service
Booking.lead: This is a booking request. A time is confirmed only after we check availability.
Booking.success: Booking request received. We will confirm a time separately — nothing is confirmed yet.
Booking.type_standard_lead: Send a visit request for an active service. Preferred times are requests only.
Booking.type_site_inspection_lead: Ask for a site inspection. This does not schedule the visit or produce a final quote.
Booking.type_emergency_lead: Tell us the urgent issue and location. This is a request, not a promised arrival time or 24/7 SLA.
Booking.type_recurring_cleaning_lead: Request a repeating cleaning visit. Frequency is a preference until a person confirms it.
Booking.type_amc_visit_lead: Request a visit under an annual maintenance arrangement. A contract is not created from this form.
Booking.notConfirmed: Preferred date and time are requests. They are not an appointment until our team contacts you.
Booking.requestNote: Submitting this form creates a request only. It does not book a slot.
Booking.emergencyNote: Emergency requests are reviewed by a person. We do not promise a response time or confirm that a technician is on the way.
Booking.receivedLead: Your appointment is not confirmed yet. Our team will review your request and contact you.

Legal.cookieBody: This site uses essential cookies to run pages and remember language.
Legal.cookieAnalytics: A first-party analytics cookie (alnajah_vid / alnajah_sid) measures page views and form activity so we can improve the service. It does not identify you until you submit a form. We do not use Google Analytics or other third-party trackers. Events are kept for 13 months.
Legal.cookieOptOutDone: Visitor analytics is off on this browser. Existing anonymous identifiers were cleared.
Legal.privacyAnalytics: We also store anonymous first-party visit events (page, service, and form activity) for up to 13 months. These are not sold, are not advertising profiles, and do not include your name, phone, email, or AI message text. You can opt out on the cookie policy page.
